content.title: Gold Prices Slip. What Could Drive Up Demand for the Precious Metal.
content.summary: Gold  prices were falling yet again on Thursday, as investors tried to figure out if a recent selloff was a mere dip, or the start of a longer decline.  The precious metal has struggled since Oct. 20, with investors deciding to sell after a stellar run that saw prices rally by over 50%.  The World Gold Council’s quarterly report, published on Thursday, showed that demand for bullion hit a record high over the third quarter thanks to a continued buying spree from investors and central banks.
